lead_raw_text:
The structure of Co3Bi crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 8 atoms (Co6Bi2) distributed over 2 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Bi and Co centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each; Bi is surrounded by 12 Co neighbors (3.323–3.497 Å), while Co environments involve 4 Bi and 8 Co neighbors (2.761–3.497 Å). The geometric neighbor graph is 3-dimensional and connected across all 8 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Co coordination polyhedra, plus corner- and edge-sharing between Bi and Co polyhedra.
